test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

His mother is staring at him.

options.text: He is being stared at by his mother.
He was stared at by his mother.
He was being stared by his mother
He is stared at by his mother.

solution:
The correct answer is "**He is being stared at by his mother.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There are a few things to keep in mind when changing the given sentence into passive voice.
 
• The **subject **in the active voice becomes the **object **in the passive voice.
 
• In the given sentence, the subject "**mother**" in the active voice becomes the object in the passive voice.
 
• In the given sentence, the auxiliary verb "**is**" followed by **being**(gerund/present participle) as the sentence is in the present continuous tense.
 
• The passive voice sentence will have "i**s being**".
 
• The main verb "**staring**" will take the past participle form "**stared**" in passive voice.
 
• The **agent**(one who performs the action) in the sentence comes after the preposition "**by**" in the passive voice.

**The correct sentence is: ***He is being stared at by his mother.*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** 

 
• The structure of the active voice sentence is : **subject + verb + object.**
 
• The structure of the passive voice sentence is :** object + verb + by + subject(agent).**
